resources.string: Manage encryption and recovery for this Google account. Google will guide you through any changes.
Continue with Google to set up on-device encryption for this account.
Continuing with Google can permanently delete every saved password and saved Wi-Fi password in this Google account.
Continuing with Google can permanently delete all passkeys saved to this Google account. You will need to create new passkeys for your online accounts.
Check and use the account’s current data, then close this change locally. The earlier request may still finish on Google. This will not repeat or undo it.
Using the verified current account data. The outcome of the earlier change was not confirmed.
The outcome still needs to be checked. Passwords and passkeys are temporarily unavailable in Services while this change is unresolved.
The current Google account state has been verified.
Keep this window open until the result is checked. If you leave, reopen this page to check the outcome.
The account state could not be verified. No change will be repeated automatically.
This device cannot open this protected Google flow.
